source_text: For any weakly decreasing integer sequence λ₁ ≥ … ≥ λ_N, there is a unique irreducible algebraic representation L_λ of GL_N with highest weight λ; it is constructed as (Schur module L_{λ+r·1^N}) ⊗ (det^*)^r for r ≫ 0
